claim.text: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth.

evidence.content: Everest's summit sits higher above sea level than any other peak on the planet.

claim.text: Photosynthesis converts sunlight into chemical energy.

evidence.content: Through photosynthesis, plants store the energy of sunlight in chemical form.
